title: Crown gaming suites
summary: Visit three new rooms for blackjack, Texas Hold'em, baccarat, craps and draw poker.
notes: Add $1 blackjack, baccarat and pass-line craps tables with shared multiplayer rounds.
Add two-to-four-player fixed-limit Texas Hold'em with private hole cards and split pots.
Add a Crown draw poker cabinet with hold controls and its displayed custom paytable.
Connect safe gaming suites to the north promenade and add GPS destinations for each room.
